relations.text: ノバとサムスン電子の研究部門が、SPIEで2本の共著論文を発表すると発表した
relations.text_en: Nova announced it will publish two co-authored papers with Samsung R&D Center research at SPIE Advanced Lithography 2024

source.label: Nova の発表
source.quote: Nova (Nasdaq: NVMI) today announced that it will publish two co-authored papers with Samsung R&D Center research at SPIE Advanced Lithography 2024.

relations.text: ノバとサムスン電子の共同論文がSPIEで賞を受け、両社の継続的な協力による成果とされた
relations.text_en: A joint Nova and Samsung paper won an SPIE award and is described as the result of continuous collaboration between the companies

source.label: Nova の発表
source.quote: The paper is a result of continuous collaboration between the companies to explore innovative approaches to metrology in advanced chip manufacturing.

relations.text: ノバはIBM Researchとの協力の一環として、ニューヨーク州オールバニの同研究所に最新の装置群を設置した

source.label: Nova の発表
source.quote: As part of the collaboration with IBM Research, Nova installed its most advanced portfolio at IBM Research’s lab in Albany, New York.

relations.text: ノバとGlobalFoundriesの共同論文が、両社の継続的な提携の成果とされた

source.quote: The paper is a result of the continuous partnership between the companies and demonstrates the innovation Nova promotes in advanced process control utilizing its unique and differentiated software solutions.
